title: Nazi Zombie Rpd
author: DemunVirus

baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: Description nazi_zombie_rpd is a map based off Resident Evil 2. Its a decently sized map with plenty of buyable weapons, plus many more. The map isnt exactly like the resident evil 2 Raccoon Police Department, but if u have played resident evil 2, i am pretty sure this map will bring back some old memories. There is a Pretty Long Hallway for a last stand… with a bunch of goodie’s, but it cost a good bit. Other – Verruckt Style – Atleast 10 buyable weapons – moving random boxes – custom electro shock defenses – Perk Machines – Zombie risers – 1 Turret – Betties – Dp28 added To Random box Bugs – Haven’t found any bug’s yet. Reply if you find any.

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
